# Animaze sub-actions

## Animaze idle animation

Changes how the current avatar moves while idle.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Idle animation** | The idle animation's name, or its number. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.idle`</small>

## Animaze pose

Puts the current avatar into one of its poses.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Pose** | The pose's name, or its number. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.pose`</small>

## Animaze virtual camera on/off

Turns Animaze's virtual camera on or off. That camera is how other apps, like OBS or Discord, see your avatar.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Virtual camera** | On or Off. Options: On, Off. Starts as: `On`. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.virtualCamera`</small>

## Load Animaze avatar

Switches Animaze to another avatar.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Avatar** | The avatar's name, as Animaze lists it. Connect first to pick from the list. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.loadAvatar`</small>

## Load Animaze background scene

Switches the background scene behind your Animaze avatar.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | The scene's name, as Animaze lists it. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.loadScene`</small>

## Load Animaze quickscene

Loads one of your saved Animaze quickscenes (avatar, background and settings together).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Quickscene** | The quickscene's name, or its number. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.quickscene`</small>

## Play Animaze emote

Plays an emote on your Animaze avatar, like Angry or Alarm.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Emote** | The emote's name. Connect first to pick from your avatar's emotes. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%animaze.emote%` | The emote's item name that Animaze played |

<small>Type id: `animaze.emote`</small>

## Play Animaze special action

Plays one of the current avatar's special actions, like waving hello.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Special action** | The special action's name, or its number. |

<small>Type id: `animaze.specialAction`</small>
